title: Sweep model depth (DEPTH=8 -> 10)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 (model_dim auto-adjusts from 512 to 640, 5 heads); everything else unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb improved from 1.014027 to 1.002496 (~1.1% relative), a clear win from a single-line change. Confirms depth was under-tuned relative to width at DEPTH=8 for this 5-min budget. Worth a small follow-up sweep (e.g. DEPTH=9, 11, 12) in a later round to find the local optimum, since going from 8->10 was already a decent step and the curve may not be flat yet.
